f.funding_coi: Vita Zahnfabrik supported the study with materials; one author is a Vita laboratory manager

f.intervention: Proposed 'esthetic width' concept for metal-ceramic restorations: margin positioning, reduced metal framework with extended porcelain shoulder, pontic and interdental design
f.main_result: Reduced frameworks with porcelain shoulders avoid the umbrella effect; ridge-lap pontics and interdental mini-wings are recommended for collapsed anterior ridges and flattened papillae.

f.population: Patients with trigeminal neuralgia in primary and secondary care
f.intervention: UK (Royal College of Surgeons of England) guidelines for diagnosis and treatment of TN: first-line carbamazepine/oxcarbazepine, MRI, neurosurgery, multidisciplinary care
f.main_result: Guidelines advise prompt diagnosis after excluding dental causes, early first-line medication, and multidisciplinary care with long-term outcomes collection.
f.funding_coi: Dr. Bahra consulted for Pfizer; Dr. Zakrzewska for Biogen and Noema Pharma
f.limitations: Guidelines depend on accurate phenotyping; surgical efficacy data come from nonrandomized single-intervention studies.

f.population: Patients with a single missing first molar and intact, vital abutments (40 FPDs)
f.intervention: Zirconia occlusal veneer FPDs with two preparation designs (D1, D2) in 3Y-TZP or 5Y-PSZ
f.comparison: Four groups: D1/D2 x 3Y-TZP/5Y-PSZ compared with each other
f.main_result: No debonding or recurrent caries; two D1/5Y FPDs fractured completely (4 and 17 months) and one D2/5Y cracked at 1 month; no significant group differences.
materials_brands: DDcubeX2 (3Y-TZP) and DDBioZX2 (5Y-PSZ) zirconia, Dental Direkt
f.funding_coi: No funding reported; no conflicts of interest
f.limitations: Cannot be placed immediately after extraction, no provisional FPD possible, complex preparation limits routine use, demanding isolation.

f.population: 5 beagle dogs (mandibular implant sites, 3 months after premolar extraction)
f.intervention: Installation of Astra Tech, Branemark (2-stage) and Bonefit-ITI (1-stage) implants, one of each per mandibular quadrant in random order
f.comparison: 1-stage (non-submerged) versus 2-stage (submerged) implant systems
f.main_result: No statistically significant differences among the three implant systems in any histometric variable; lamellar bone density was 85.4% (Astra), 87.4% (Branemark) and 88.4% (Bonefit).
f.follow_up: 3 months healing plus 6 months plaque control

f.population: 156 consecutive fully edentulous patients
f.intervention: Fixed prostheses on 4 or 6 screw-shaped titanium Branemark implants
f.comparison: Prostheses on 4 implants versus 6 implants
f.main_result: Survival of prostheses and of individual implants was the same with 4 or 6 implants at 10 years (implant survival lower jaw 88.4% vs 93.2%, upper jaw 80.3% vs 78.3%).
f.sample_size: 156 patients; mandible 13 prostheses on 4 and 59 on 6 implants, maxilla 14 and 70
f.limitations: Smoking habits and surgical aspects such as dehiscences or fenestrations could not be analyzed.

f.population: 11 patients (27-77 years) each receiving two ITI implants in the same quadrant
f.intervention: ITI implants placed with the polished-surface border about 1 mm subcrestal
f.comparison: Control implants with the rough/smooth border at the alveolar crest
f.main_result: Test implants lost 2.26 mm and control implants 1.02 mm of bone height in the first year; test implants' bone level was 0.38 mm lower at 12 months.
f.funding_coi: Clinical Research Foundation (CRF), University of Bern

f.population: 22-year-old male with active decay on the distofacial cusp tip of a second molar (single case)
f.intervention: Stress Reducing Direct Composite (SRDC) technique: wedge-shaped dentin increments, flowable base, progressive/pulse curing
f.funding_coi: Authors declare no financial interest in the products cited

f.population: One beagle dog with artificial periodontal defects on premolar roots
f.intervention: Cultured autologous periodontal ligament cells seeded on planed root surfaces under mucoperiosteal flaps
f.comparison: Opposite side, same treatment without cell seeding
f.main_result: Seeded root surfaces were almost completely covered with cementoblasts and showed new attachment on all 6 sites, whereas controls showed epithelial downgrowth.
f.limitations: Done in only one dog with artificial defects; more dogs and natural defects are needed before clinical testing.

f.population: 14 sites in 8 subjects with less than 2 mm keratinised gingiva and pocketing under 1 mm
f.intervention: Free connective tissue grafts harvested by three methods to widen keratinised gingiva
f.main_result: Keratinised attached gingiva width increased significantly (graft width about 5.5 mm, 4.58 mm at 6 months) with mean contraction of 28%, and tissue was histologically normal.

f.population: 58 adults with 71 single Branemark fixtures and their adjacent teeth
f.intervention: Single-tooth replacement with Branemark implants
outcomes: marginal bone loss at tooth surfaces facing implants
effect of tooth-fixture distance and jaw region
f.main_result: Bone loss at adjacent tooth surfaces averaged 0.97 mm up to crown installation versus 0.08 mm the following year, largest at lateral upper incisors and increasing with smaller fixture-tooth distance.
f.follow_up: up to 3 years after crown installation
materials_brands: Branemark System fixtures, standard and self-tapping (Nobelpharma)

f.main_result: Peri-implant esthetic outcome of single-tooth replacement can be predicted from five diagnostic keys: relative tooth position, form and biotype of the periodontium, tooth shape and position of the osseous crest.

f.population: 30 patients needing increased VDO (3 to 5 mm): natural-teeth controls and implant-supported groups
f.intervention: Increasing VDO with fixed implant-supported restorations opposing natural teeth or implant restorations
f.comparison: Group A: fixed restorations on natural dentition opposing natural dentition
f.main_result: All 30 patients adapted to the new VDO; group A had more bone loss and tooth failures and group C more mechanical complications such as porcelain fractures (P<.05).
Careful evaluation of etiology, history and occlusal vertical dimension is essential for planning restoration of extreme wear; an interspecialty team approach assures longevity.

f.population: 39 patients with Branemark implants supporting full-arch or partial fixed reconstructions
f.intervention: Clinical examination of peri-implant soft tissue condition in relation to width of masticatory mucosa
f.comparison: Sites with inadequate (<2 mm) versus adequate (>2 mm) width of masticatory mucosa
f.main_result: Neither width of masticatory mucosa nor marginal tissue mobility significantly influenced plaque control or bleeding on probing; 24% of sites lacked masticatory mucosa and 61% of implants showed facial tissue mobility.
f.follow_up: More than 10 years (full-arch) or more than 5 years (partial) after reconstruction

f.main_result: Smooth titanium surfaces are proposed to give inadequate biomechanical coupling with bone, so the stress range they induce is too limited to maintain crestal bone, unlike textured surfaces.
f.limitations: Authors state the report addresses only strain-related processes and purposely omits infection, molecular surface features, bioactive molecules and bone structure differences.

materials_brands: n!ce glass-ceramic (Straumann), lithium aluminosilicate ceramic reinforced with lithium disilicate

f.population: Ninety Sprague-Dawley rats, divided into three diet groups
f.intervention: Rearing on a gruel-like soft diet, or soft diet with dry pellets one day in seven
f.comparison: Group I fed hard pelleted rat chow
f.funding_coi: Biomedical Research Support Grant from Wright State University

f.population: Five adult Finnish sheep, 20 titanium implants placed in the forehead
f.intervention: Horizontal loading of implants with orthodontic elastics (250 to 350 g) for 3 months
f.main_result: No infection or bone loss around implants; histology showed firm bone-titanium interfaces under constant lateral force.
materials_brands: Straumann plasma-sprayed pure titanium implants, 4.5 mm long, 3.5 mm diameter
f.funding_coi: Institut Straumann, Waldenburg, Switzerland

f.population: 467 consecutive patients (500 jaws) treated with Branemark fixtures
f.intervention: Standard, self-tapping and conical Branemark fixtures; effect of occlusal overload examined in fixed full prostheses and overdentures
f.comparison: Standard versus self-tapping fixtures; with versus without overload factors
f.main_result: Standard fixtures failed more often than self-tapping fixtures with no difference in bone loss; excessive bone loss or fixture loss correlated with lack of anterior contact, parafunction and opposing osseointegrated full prostheses.

f.population: Four Macaca fascicularis monkeys with 5 screw-type titanium implants each in the mandible (20 implants)
f.intervention: Excessive lateral occlusal load via supra-occlusal fixed partial prosthesis, or plaque accumulation via cotton cord
f.comparison: Implants with plaque accumulation versus implants with excessive occlusal load
f.main_result: 5 of 8 implants with excessive occlusal load lost osseointegration, whereas none with plaque accumulation did, although they lost 1.8 mm of bone on average after 18 months.
materials_brands: Astra Tech screw-type commercially pure titanium implants (TiO2-blasted and machined)
f.funding_coi: Danish Medical Research Council and Astra Tech AB, Sweden

materials_brands: TISSEEL fibrin sealant (human fibrinogen, synthetic aprotinin, human thrombin)

f.population: A 60-year-old male dentist with a severely worn dentition and lost vertical dimension (single representative case)
f.intervention: Stepwise increase of vertical dimension of occlusion with composite stops, provisionals and full-coverage restorations
f.main_result: A step-by-step chairside protocol is described for increasing VDO by about 1.5 to 2 mm at the second molars (3:1 at the incisors) when restoring severely worn dentition.
f.limitations: Author notes the inevitable risk of porcelain fracture or tooth fracture and the technique sensitivity of these cases.
